node.statement: For each index j, the real number a_j = P_{vj} satisfies a_j = a_j^+ - a_j^-, where a_j^+ = max(a_j, 0) and a_j^- = max(-a_j, 0).
node.inference: by_definition (case split on the sign of a_j: if a_j >= 0 then a_j^+ = a_j and a_j^- = 0; if a_j < 0 then a_j^+ = 0 and a_j^- = -a_j)
